svg.text: A day at station SUU near Nephi: Monday, October 26, 2026 (filtered 1–10 Hz)
Each line is 30 minutes: read across, then down. Minutes into the line:
12:47 am to 1:09 am: bursts that only this station felt
10:10 am: gaps, no data for 53 seconds
11:33 am to 11:48 am: five bursts not in the catalog. What were they?
5:33 pm: quarry blast near Leamington, magnitude 2.1, 53 km away
6:17 pm: quake under Mount Nebo, magnitude 1.3, 19 km away
7:17 pm: small quake near Mona, magnitude 0.8, 20 km away
Utah time (MDT). Lines alternate dark and blue. Big swings are cut off at a line and a half
above or below their own line, like ink running off a paper drum.
